previous_statement: The fixed lem-maincb-stage2-raw-extension witness package and W.e_s2<=min{e_s2^0,e_2}, together with the respective producer smallness hypotheses, apply to that exact datum and yield its literal u_2:M_{r+1}->A_R as an extended D_2 t-isomorphism with ||u_2(I_{M_{r+1}})-u_{A_R}||<=D_2 t; since 0<=t and D_2<=D_*, both defect bounds weaken to D_*t.
new_statement: The fixed lem-maincb-stage2-raw-extension witness package and W.e_s2<=min{e_s2^0,e_2}, together with the respective producer smallness hypotheses, apply to the exact closed EXT-CB datum furnished by lem-maincb-stage2-call-envelope and produce a witness v_+:M_{r+1}->A_R that is an extended D_2 t-isomorphism with ||v_+(I_{M_{r+1}})-u_{A_R}||<=D_2 t. Choose such a witness and form the Stage-2 def-maincb-raw-call record with its literal output map and fixed amplification family defined to be u_2:=v_+ and the amplification family of v_+. Therefore the literal u_2 has both asserted D_2 t bounds; since 0<=t and D_2<=D_*, both bounds weaken to D_*t.
